name: Lahad
overview: Lahad is a male figure from the tribe of Judah, identified in Scripture as the son of Jahath. Beyond this familial connection, there are no additional notes or details about his life or deeds recorded in the biblical text.
namesAndTitles: The name Lahad is a proper name that possibly means 'slow' or 'indolent.' This meaning is not explicitly given by God but is derived from linguistic interpretation as noted in 1 Chronicles 4:2.
familyAndRelationships: Scripture records Lahad as the son of Jahath, establishing a direct father-son relationship. No other family relationships are documented beyond this connection.
scriptureSignificance: Lahad's significance in the biblical narrative is primarily genealogical, as he is listed among the descendants in the tribe of Judah. His mention helps preserve the lineage and heritage important to the biblical record, though no further narrative role or spiritual significance is attributed to him in the text.
